-- simple text --
<x>APPLE <y>BANANA</y> CHERRY</x>
-- want --
<x>
	APPLE
	<y>
		BANANA
	</y>
	CHERRY
</x>

-- simple self-closing --
<x>APPLE<y/>BANANA</x>
-- want --
<x>
	APPLE
	<y/>
	BANANA
</x>

-- remove space between nodes --
<x>

	APPLE

		<y/>

			BANANA

				</x>
-- want --
<x>
	APPLE
	<y/>
	BANANA
</x>

-- normalize space inside text node --
<x>
	APPLE

		BANANA
</x>
-- want --
<x>
	APPLE BANANA
</x>

-- attrs --
<foo a="Bar" b="Baz"></foo>
-- want --
<foo a="Bar" b="Baz">
</foo>

-- attrs self-closing --
<foo a="Bar" b="Baz"/>
-- want --
<foo a="Bar" b="Baz"/>

-- escape attr val --
<foo a="&quot; Bar &quot;"/>
-- want --
<foo a="&#34; Bar &#34;"/>

-- sort attrs --
<foo c="" a="" b=""/>
-- want --
<foo a="" b="" c=""/>

-- sort id class rest --
<foo b="" a="" class="" id=""/>
-- want --
<foo id="" class="" a="" b=""/>

-- sort id rest --
<foo b="" a="" id=""/>
-- want --
<foo id="" a="" b=""/>

-- sort class rest --
<foo b="" a="" class=""/>
-- want --
<foo class="" a="" b=""/>

-- boolean attr --
<foo a/>
-- want --
<foo a=""/>
